Terra One ist ein Technologieunternehmen, das AI-Modelle entwickelt, um Batteriespeicher automatisiert zu steuern und das europäische Stromnetz zu stabilisieren.

Terra One , a startup specializing in grid-connected battery energy storage solutions, secured $7.5 million in seed funding, led by PT1, an early-stage venture capital firm specializing in real asset technologies, and neosfer, an early-stage investor associated with Commerzbank.
